notes: Backbone-comparison arm. Every field below is copied verbatim from metra_joint.json except image_encoder, so the difference between the two runs is the image backbone and nothing else. fusion.embed_dim stays 768: the ResNet encoder projects its 512-wide feature map up to 768 (see encoders.TimmResNet), otherwise fusion.embed_dim would be forced down to the backbone width and the comparison would vary in fusion width too. Residual difference that cannot be removed: 50 image tokens (7x7 grid + CLS) versus 197 for ViT-B/16 at 224. Keep image_encoder.freeze in step with the ViT arm; the team's data strategy calls for frozen backbones, but metra_joint.json currently leaves freeze at its default (false).
